description: A modern .NET 10 client library for interacting with the Tropic (tropicapp.io) API.

Geliştirme servisleri: uygulama açılırken veritabanı, Redis, RabbitMQ gibi servisler bilgisayarda kuruluysa onları kullanır, değilse docker-compose ile yalnızca gerekenleri başlatır. Yalnızca Development'ta çalışır.

Development'ta OpenAPI belgesini Postman'e aktarır ve her açılışta aynı koleksiyonu günceller (kopya oluşturmaz); baseUrl'li bir ortam (environment) da hazırlar. Anahtar user-secrets'ta (Postman:ApiKey); yoksa hiçbir şey yapmaz.

H.264, H.265 and AV1 video encoders and decoders for Agash.StreamTransport on FFmpeg: Direct3D 12, NVENC, AMF, QSV, Vulkan, VA-API, VideoToolbox and software backends behind the Media codec contracts, fed from GPU surfaces without a copy where the backend allows. Bring FFmpeg 9 shared libraries.
Linux media for Agash.StreamTransport: PipeWire video and audio sources and sinks, and Vulkan video processors for colour conversion and side-by-side alpha on DMA-BUFs.

Opus audio encoder and decoder for Agash.StreamTransport on libopus (LibOpus.Interop): 20 ms packets with capture timestamps, in-band FEC, live bitrate changes and packet loss concealment, behind the Media audio contracts. Allocation-free per packet.
WHIP and WHEP endpoints for Agash.StreamTransport in an ASP.NET Core application: ingest from OBS or a browser, play to browsers, mapped onto the host's own routing.
Transport-independent media adaptation for Agash.StreamTransport: pacing by traffic class and the aggregate send budget that media, retransmission and FEC share.
Windows media for Agash.StreamTransport: Direct3D 12 video processors for colour conversion and side-by-side alpha, Spout sources and sinks, and WASAPI audio.

ASP.NET Core JWT API helpers for session-bound tokens: compact access tokens (sub/sid/jti/exp), per-request session validation with a short in-memory cache, non-rotating refresh token codec and sliding session expiry.

ASP.NET Core web (BFF) authentication against a separate JWT API: API access/refresh tokens kept only in the encrypted auth cookie, a DelegatingHandler that attaches the bearer and refreshes it, a middleware that builds the current user from the API, and session-expiry handling.

In-process stale-while-refresh caches (single value and keyed) with group-based invalidation through a registry keyed by an app-defined enum, plus an optional HTTP channel to invalidate caches in another process.
In-process dispatch queue with pluggable admission policies (concurrency caps, composite policies), fair round-robin scheduling by an app-defined key, bounded waiting lists and awaitable tickets.
Webhooks for Webority support: the ticket events a product's own systems subscribe to, delivered through Webority.Webhooks.
Reusable Blazor UI component library for building consistent user interfaces across Esyasoft applications.
Clash detection engine: mesh intersection search by rules, without the Revit API.
Clash detection geometry format: tessellated element meshes in millimetres, binary read and write.
Clash image renderer: CPU rasterization of a collision inside a section box to PNG, without the Revit API.
UI-free Revit extractor for clash detection: tessellated element geometry in shared coordinates, parameters and MEP connectivity.
Clash detection rules: selection sets, matrix of checks and tolerances.
macOS media for Agash.StreamTransport: Metal video processors for colour conversion and side-by-side alpha on IOSurfaces, Syphon sources and sinks, and Core Audio through AVAudioEngine.
